articles.title: Blackstone Weighs Energy And ICT Exits While Eyeing IPL Cricket Stake
articles.mainIdea: Blackstone Weighs Energy And ICT Exits While Eyeing IPL Cricket Stake
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Blackstone Weighs Energy And ICT Exits While Eyeing IPL Cricket Stake. Blackstone (NYSE:BX) is exploring a potential sale of Beacon Offshore Energy as part of a wider portfolio reshaping effort. The firm is also weighing options for Interplex Holdings’ ICT unit, including a possible sale. Separately, Blackstone is assessing bids for a stake in Indian Premier League franchise Royal Challengers Bengaluru, signaling interest in major sports assets.
